note: Proposed tag-schema corrections so the schemas describe the data the vault actually holds (qa/vault-health.md, 2026-10-08). Schema-only: no note is rewritten. `from` is the definition the change expects to find (as in packages/core/src/lib/schemas/tag-schemas.json); `to` is the complete new definition of that field. apply-schema-fixes.ts compares type/enum/default only and skips a field whose live definition matches neither (drift). Items marked optional are applied only with --include-optional and are deliberately NOT in tag-schemas.json (so a plain `npm run seed` cannot add them). Awaiting Benjamin's approval.
